# 九位 AI 原画 · 高清临摹

九幅均以各自上传的原画为参照。每页沿用原服装、三视图和局部设定，导出宽度从 1280 像素提高到 2560 像素，高度按对应原图同比例增至两倍。

此单文件在文内嵌入九幅全分辨率 WebP 和一张局部对照图，可在支持内嵌图片的 Markdown 阅读器中离线查看。

![九幅上传原画与高清临摹的局部对照][art-overview]

九幅先用 ImageGen 逐图临摹，再经超分辨率处理，以原画的两倍尺寸导出。面部表情、发丝、纹饰和小字由临摹稿呈现，细部与原画会有差异。 [Real-ESRGAN 项目](https://github.com/xinntao/Real-ESRGAN)

## DeepSeek · 鲸纹女仆

鲸鳍耳侧系着水蓝蝴蝶结，围裙边缘的荷叶褶一直绕到腰后。细节栏并列眨眼和双手贴近脸颊的两种笑容。

## 临摹提示词

每幅以对应的上传原图作为图像输入。完整提示词由共用段落和该角色的两行专属说明依次组成。

### 共用段落

```text
This is a fidelity-first hand-drawn facsimile / clean-line redraw of the one attached illustrated character reference sheet. Re-ink the SAME existing art at exceptionally crisp high resolution for zooming, as if the original artwork's clean master has been recovered. Treat the reference as the final canvas to trace, not as a loose design prompt. Reproduce the full original page edge-to-edge: same illustration style, face proportions and expression, gaze, exact body gestures, clothing and props, hairstyles, colors, restrained shading, and number/order/crops of detail panels. Front, side and rear should register at their same relative positions; keep all visible feet, long hair, tails and original borders. Restore fine, graceful, anti-aliased linework: individually tapered hair strands, delicate eyes and eyelashes, embroidered seams and small metalwork, with smooth unbanded color, clean paper-white and softly graded shadows. Clean compression haze and color bleeding without plastic blur, halos, thick contours, artificial grunge, oversaturation or any redesign. Keep the original typography, brand heading, captions, readable writing, footnotes, little icons and existing marks in their original locations and sizes. Do not add additional text, labels, new clothing, new ornaments or a different layout. Deliver a flat finished illustrated page, not a photograph, web mockup, or comparison. The only attachment is the original sheet to redraw.
```

### DeepSeek

```text
Request a native 2304 × 3456 pixel portrait master at largest available detail and match the source aspect ratio.
DeepSeek. Match the very same indigo-to-powder-blue hair, curled ahoge, cyan bows on lateral whale-fin ears, blue eyes and whale flukes. In front she lifts one side of her navy dress, with the other palm raised. Reproduce the white frilled maid band, white pinafore with blue whale emblem, dark neck bow, layered navy skirt with gold sprigs, white stockings, Mary Janes, and large back bow. Retain the distinctive lower layout of TWO different face expressions, the individual accessory tiles, original corner ornaments, swatches and lower-right signature exactly where they occur. Use the same little rounded whale icon.
```

The source's tall decorative X-shaped fantasy staff stays at the same scale and in the same place in front view; copy it as a pictured costume accessory. ```
